question: In the following circuit, the equivalent capacitance between terminal $A$ and terminal $B$ is :
diagram_alt: Bridge of five 2 μF capacitors between A and B: two in the top branch, two in the bottom branch and one joining their midpoints
solution:
The four outer capacitors form a Wheatstone bridge with the middle $2\ \mu$F capacitor as the bridge. All four arms are equal ($2\ \mu$F each), so the bridge is balanced: the two middle junctions are at the same potential and the middle capacitor has no charge.

Each outer branch is two $2\ \mu$F capacitors in series: $1\ \mu$F.

Two such branches in parallel:
$$C_{AB} = 1 + 1 = 2\ \mu\text{F}$$
